campaigns.name: e4_mhd3d
campaigns.description: E4: saturated 3D MHD dynamo, constant ABC forcing at kf = 2, ν = 0.05 (Re = 10), 11 magnetic diffusivities η from 0.08 to 0.03, 16³ grid, 24 trajectories × 100 snapshots per η.

models.name: e4/G0/seed0
models.architecture: Gaussian law, one 8 × 8 covariance per Fourier mode, interpolated in η
models.constraint_mechanism: vector potentials (zero divergence by design); B → −B symmetry of the covariance
models.weights: closed form: milady.train.constraints.ModewiseGaussian(sign=…).fit(x_train, c_train), refitted from the data set in under 1 s
models.regenerate: python3 tools/runpod_job.py run --hours 1.9 --outputs experiments/results/replications/e4_nongauss -- env E4_SAME_DATA=1 E4_SAVE_MODELS=1 bash experiments/e4_gpu_job.sh full '0 1 2 3 4' e4_nongauss D,E,G,N

models.name: e4/W9/seed0
models.architecture: conditional flow matching on the potentials: ResMLP (width 512, depth 4) plus an explicit mode-wise affine term
models.constraint_mechanism: vector potentials (zero divergence by design); velocity field equivariant under B → −B
models.weights: not kept (the pod of the job was deleted); retrained by the job below in about 1 min per seed on a GPU

models.name: e4/W16/seed0
models.architecture: samples of W9 sent through the linear map that gives them the mean and covariance of G1 (estimated on 131 072 samples per η)
models.constraint_mechanism: vector potentials; first two moments of the law imposed at sampling time
models.weights: no weights of its own: W9 plus the map, recomputed at sampling time
